pipeline.name: preflight
pipeline.description: Verify no uncommitted changes before release
pipeline.run: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || (echo 'Uncommitted changes found — commit them first' && exit 1)

pipeline.name: clippy
pipeline.on_error: echo 'clippy failed — fix warnings before releasing'

pipeline.name: stage_fmt
pipeline.description: Commit any formatting changes from cargo fmt
pipeline.run: if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then git add src-tauri/src && git commit -m 'chore: apply cargo fmt'; fi

pipeline.name: calc_version
pipeline.description: Compute new version (auto-increment patch or use release_version)
pipeline.run: CV='{{ current_version }}'; RV='{{ release_version }}'; if [ -n "$RV" ]; then echo "$RV"; else IFS='.' read -r MAJ MIN PAT <<< "$CV"; echo "${MAJ}.${MIN}.$((PAT + 1))"; fi

pipeline.name: bump
pipeline.description: Update version in Cargo.toml, tauri.conf.json, package.json
pipeline.run: CV='{{ current_version }}'; NV='{{ new_version }}'; sed -i '' "s/^version = \"${CV}\"/version = \"${NV}\"/" src-tauri/Cargo.toml && sed -i '' "s/\"version\": \"${CV}\"/\"version\": \"${NV}\"/" src-tauri/tauri.conf.json package.json && (cd src-tauri && cargo update -p piu 2>/dev/null || true)

pipeline.name: commit
pipeline.description: Commit version bump and create tag
pipeline.run: git add -A && git commit -m 'chore: bump version to {{ new_version }}' && git tag -a 'v{{ new_version }}' -m 'Release v{{ new_version }}'

pipeline.name: push
pipeline.description: Push commit and tag to origin
pipeline.run: git push origin {{ branch }} && git push origin 'v{{ new_version }}'
pipeline.on_error: sleep 2 && git push origin {{ branch }} && git push origin 'v{{ new_version }}'

pipeline.name: ci_wait
pipeline.description: Wait for GitHub Actions to register runs

pipeline.name: ci_watch
pipeline.description: Watch release workflow to completion (7–15 min)
pipeline.run: RELEASE_RUN=$(gh run list --repo {{ repo }} --workflow release.yml --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId') && gh run watch --repo {{ repo }} $RELEASE_RUN --exit-status
pipeline.on_error: echo 'Release CI failed' && gh run list --repo {{ repo }} --workflow release.yml --limit 1

pipeline.name: notes
args:
Generate concise GitHub release notes from these commits between {{ prev_version }} and {{ version }}:

{{ changelog }}

Rules:
- Categorize: New Features (feat:), Bug Fixes (fix:), Improvements (refactor/perf), Maintenance (chore/ci/docs)
- Omit empty sections
- One-line bullets, no commit hashes
- End with: **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dickwu/piu/compare/{{ prev_version }}...{{ version }}

pipeline.name: publish_notes
pipeline.description: Update the GitHub release with generated notes

pipeline.name: update_brew
pipeline.description: Pull latest Homebrew tap and upgrade local PIU install
pipeline.run: cd /opt/homebrew/Library/Taps/dickwu/homebrew-tap && git pull && brew upgrade --cask piu
pipeline.on_error: echo 'Brew upgrade failed — try: brew update && brew upgrade --cask piu'
